name: focused-business-transitions

populatedDeliveryExtension.coverageScope: Coverage is checked immediately after each word's attached test batch; later runs reset the latest-batch evidence.

fidelityBoundary: Provider results are explicit pure values; no external payment or email provider is invoked. Error codes and Store projections are compared to the F# oracle; Flow preserves raw provider error text while the F# DomainError formatter prefixes it. AgentLang record constructors are public, so supplemental invalid Product and PaymentReceipt boundary cases cannot be represented as valid F# domain records.
